name: Oracle of Relphi Canonical Glyph System

plain.description: Canonical master geometry with the enclosing circle hidden.

inscribed.description: The same canonical master geometry with the enclosing circle visible.

rules: Do not substitute Unicode glyphs when a canonical asset exists.
Do not create separate geometry for plain and inscribed variants.
Do not use legacy wheel glyph renderers as a source of truth.
Consumers must use the registry and component named above.
